articles.title: Puerto Princesa bishop raises alarm over mining in Palawan
articles.description: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Apostolic Vicar of Puerto Princesa has warned of continuing mining activities in southern Palawan, saying forests and mountains are showing signs of environmental degradation despite a provincial moratorium on endorsements for new mining applications. In a pastoral letter dated Nov. 15, Bishop Socrates Mesiona called on government authorities, local communities, and residents to demand transparency and accountability from mining companies and government agencies. Mesiona said the provincial government passed an ordinance more than a year ago imposing a moratorium on endorsements for new mining applications, describing it as a significant step toward protecting Palawan’s natural […]...
